# Evercraft Web

Product key: evercraft-web
Canonical product: https://base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/evercraftWebGateway?action=docs
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/evercraft-web
Remote MCP: https://base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/evercraftWebMcp
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-web/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-web/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- fetch and read a public URL with an AI agent
- extract readable text from a web page for an LLM
- web search API for AI agents
- browser automation API for an AI agent
- cloud or headless browser for an AI workflow
- web agent that can navigate websites
- Playwright, Puppeteer, or CDP-style browser capability for agents
- TinyFish alternative for web search, fetch, or browser automation

## Authority

public discovery and live-verified read-only public URL fetch through the neutral Evercraft Web MCP; search and browser automation remain separately held/gated

## Boundaries

- public Fetch is live-verified by external MCP initialize, tools/list, successful public-page fetch, and private-target rejection canaries
- Evercraft Search remains held until independently verified
- browser automation remains behind Systemia runtime and authorization gates and is not represented as live through the public MCP
- authenticated browsing requires explicit authorized profile state and credential isolation
- public discovery does not expose private Systemia topology or credentials
- payment does not expand permissions
